# Safety By Design

> > Houston-based safety consulting firm providing OSHA compliance training, workplace safety programs, and safety staffing services for construction, manufacturing, and industrial sectors in Texas.

Safety By Design Inc specializes in OSHA compliance solutions including PSM (Process Safety Management), HAZWOPER training, medical surveillance programs, and emergency response staffing with EMT/paramedic personnel. The company serves industries across Texas with comprehensive safety consulting, written program development, and specialized training from OSHA 30-Hour courses to active shooter preparedness.

- OSHA Compliance
- Workplace Safety Training
- Safety Staffing Services
- Process Safety Management (PSM)
- HAZWOPER Certification
- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- Construction Safety
- Industrial Safety
- Emergency Preparedness
- Medical Surveillance
- Safety Culture Development
- Fire Watch Training
- Hearing Conservation Programs

- Safety Program Audits
